description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of Reference Answer and Test Case" illustrates the proportion of different categories within a dataset. There are three slices representing the categories "Null," "Have reference answer," and "Have test case." The "Null" category, colored in light red, constitutes the largest portion of the chart with an approximate value of 38.9%. The "Have reference answer" slice, in light blue, is the second largest, representing about 38.9% of the dataset. The "Have test case" slice, in light green, makes up the smallest portion with roughly 21.9%. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, which correlates the colors to the respective categories. Each slice is labeled with its category name and the corresponding percentage, and the chart is designed with a circular shape to accurately represent the proportions of each category.
